film: Spirited Away (Sen to Chihiro no kamikakushi)
methodology: Counts are hand-tagged from the Japanese dialogue track for three focal scenes. Categories are coarse proxies: desu/masu counts finite predicate endings; sonkeigo/bun counts honorific verb auxiliaries and lexical substitutions toward superiors; plain/imperative counts bare stems and direct commands. Use these tables to justify link distance (formality) and node zTarget (uchi–soto / social distance), not as exhaustive linguistic annotation.

scenes.title: Bathhouse contract / name theft (Yubaba vs Chihiro)
scenes.dialogueFocus: Yubaba’s coercive questioning and Chihiro’s minimal, pressured replies.
scenes.rationale: High asymmetry: addressee-directed honorific/lowering toward Yubaba is sparse; Yubaba issues directives with low addressee honorification.

mappingToGraph.linkDistance: Base link length follows d = 6 + 2.2×formality + 0.9×socialDistance; honorificLinkMetrics.js subtracts a small term when hierarchy salience is high (upward deferral toward higher basePower) so power-relevant dyads sit closer in 3D while still honoring the scene-based scales.
mappingToGraph.linkStrength: d3 link strength is honorificLinkStrength(link): stronger when hierarchy salience is high so salient power ties pull the layout tighter.
mappingToGraph.edgeDrawing: Line width, opacity, and dash motion also scale with hierarchy salience to foreground asymmetric honorification.
mappingToGraph.zAxis: Node zTarget drives forceZ (orthogonal to basePower on forceY): interpret sign/magnitude as uchi–soto or social-depth stance in your essay and keep node notes consistent.
